spanish: Y el vestido o la urdimbre o la trama o todo utensilio de la piel que lavarás, y se apartó desde ellos la plaga, y será lavado segunda, y será puro.

findings.issue: Vqq3ms is a qal sequential perfect continuing the future force of the piel imperfect; preterite “se apartó” places the departure in the past.
Feminine ordinal absolute is adverbial “a second time”; bare feminine “segunda” disagrees with masculine “lavado” and does not clearly mark the second occasion.

notes: The later sequential perfects are future (“será lavado”, “será puro”); only the departure is past.
